test_title: RRB ALP CBT-I 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Nov, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: For which book did Gaurav Pandey win the Sahitya Akademi Yuva Puraskar in 2024?

options.text: Smritiyon Ke Beech Ghiri Hai Prithvi

solution:
The correct answer is **Smritiyon Ke Beech Ghiri Hai Prithvi .**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Sahitya Akademi announced the winners of the Yuva Puraskar and Bal Sahitya Puraskar for 2024, including K. Vaishali (English) for her memoir "Homeless: Growing up Lesbian and Dyslexic in India," and Gaurav Pandey (Hindi) for his poetry collection "Smritiyon Ke Beech Ghiri Hai Prithvi."
